title: CanonicalTelemetryEvent
description: Standard event envelope for Agent tool calls, skill executions, and target App perceptions

event_id.description: Unique UUID for the event record

trace_id.description: Global task/session trace ID across the entire interaction

span_id.description: Specific step or tool invocation span ID

parent_span_id.description: Optional parent span ID for nested skill/tool invocations

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within this producer session

capture_run.description: Grouping key for a specific continuous execution run or batch

level.description: L0: Atomic action/UI frame; L1: Intent tool/skill call; L2: Incident/error/veto

category.description: Event category, e.g., tool_call, skill_step, target_app_action, perception_frame, error

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event creation

payload.description: Structured sanitized event payload (e.g. tool name, args, latency_ms, status)

data_sanitized.description: Must be true; asserts that the payload has passed DataSanitizer
